shortDescription: The FTSE 100 Index decreased 7 points or 0.07 percent on Monday to close at 10824 points.The decline was led by Entain (-2.54%), Relx (-2.33%) and St. Jamess (-2.28%).On the upside, the strongest performers were Standard Life (1.98%), Centrica (1.70%) and Smiths (1.58%).
